name: current GitHub connector arbitrary-binary readback classification

probes.note: reported blob SHA stayed correct while rendered content changed

probes.statement: Responses must contain UTF-8 text; binary downloads are not supported.

probes.relevance: workflow-artifact-only, not repository file readback; quota-bearing hosted workflow route is not an accepted substitute

positive_boundary.blob_identity_readback: PASS: published path exposes the Git blob SHA and it can be compared to the create_blob-returned desired SHA
positive_boundary.some_binary_payload_content_rendering: sometimes exact, as in the 16-octet first fixture, but not reliable generically

implication: Use Git Data for exact binary materialization/path identity when file existence is the useful outcome. Do not claim scheduled-Chat binary roundtrip/replay for arbitrary bytes until a connector action returns exact base64/raw bytes without UTF-8 coercion.
scope: Current exposed GitHub connector actions only; this is not a claim about GitHub REST API itself, which documents base64 blob content, but about the Chat connector's readable surfaces.
